port.label: Port Condition X-Ray
port.detail: Gale-force winds possible within 48 hours. Ocean-going vessels must plan departure or request approval to stay.

port.label: Port Condition Yankee
port.detail: Port closed to inbound traffic. Ocean-going vessels departing; inbound ships holding at the offshore anchorage.

port.label: Port Condition Zulu
port.detail: Ship channel closed to all traffic. Vessels at the anchorage putting to sea.

port.label: Closed
port.detail: Channel closed after Hurricane Rafael. Damage surveys and oil spill response under way.

port.label: Partially open
port.detail: Channel partly reopened. Inner channel restricted for spill decontamination; anchorage backlog.

port.label: Closed
port.detail: Channel closed after an explosion near the Port Aransas jetties. Security sweep under way.

port.label: Open
port.detail: Channel open to all traffic after a full sweep. Exports resuming.

alerts.en: Hurricane watch in effect for the Coastal Bend. Rafael could approach the coast within 48 hours.
alerts.es: Aviso de huracán en efecto para el Coastal Bend. Rafael podría acercarse a la costa en 48 horas.

alerts.en: Hurricane warning: Rafael expected to make landfall near Port Aransas. Finish preparations now.
alerts.es: Advertencia de huracán: se espera que Rafael toque tierra cerca de Port Aransas. Termine sus preparativos ahora.

alerts.en: Mandatory evacuation ordered for Zone A: the barrier islands and low-lying surge areas. Shelters are open inland.
alerts.es: Evacuación obligatoria para la Zona A: las islas de barrera y las áreas bajas de marejada. Los albergues están abiertos tierra adentro.

alerts.en: Mandatory evacuation extended to Zones B and C; Zones A, B and C must leave. Shelters are open inland.
alerts.es: Evacuación obligatoria para las zonas de marejada A, B y C. Los albergues están abiertos tierra adentro.

alerts.en: Shelter in place. Hurricane Rafael is making landfall. Do not go outside.
alerts.es: Refúgiese donde está. El huracán Rafael está tocando tierra. No salga.

alerts.en: Citywide boil-water notice: bring water to a rolling boil for two minutes before drinking or cooking.
alerts.es: Aviso de hervir agua en toda la ciudad: hierva el agua durante dos minutos antes de beberla o cocinar.

alerts.en: Boil-water notice for Districts 3 and 4. Do not drink tap water without boiling it first.
alerts.es: Aviso de hervir agua para los Distritos 3 y 4. No beba agua de la llave sin hervirla primero.

alerts.en: Fishing and shellfish harvesting closed in Nueces and Corpus Christi bays because of the oil spill.
alerts.es: Pesca y recolección de mariscos cerradas en las bahías de Nueces y Corpus Christi por el derrame de petróleo.

harborline6.note: Transmitter off the air. Web updates continue.

coastline.note: On the air on generator power.

kncb.note: Transmisor fuera del aire. Las noticias en la web continúan.
